From the moment she stepped in, it was as if she had been part of the practice for years. Despite being a temporary doctor, she brought a level of dedication, warmth, and personal connection that many permanent practitioners aspire to.

Dr Howard has an extraordinary gift—not only is she incredibly knowledgeable and thorough, but she also has a deeply compassionate and intuitive approach. She took the time to truly listen, making myself and both my children feel heard, valued, and understood. Every interaction with her feels personal, thoughtful, and genuine. She never rushed, never overlooked a detail, and her calm, reassuring manner made all the difference.

Dr Dawn Howard is not only an outstanding clinician but a truly special human being. Any practice would be lucky to have her, even for a day.
